nodes.name: Fix Extension Dispatch Proposal
nodes.summary: Identifies two bugs in the VS Code extension: search and query chat commands both incorrectly route to handleQueryMemory (missing scored semantic search via POST /memory/search), and the fully-implemented causal REST API has no LM tool registered making it invisible to Copilot agents. Proposes splitting dispatch, adding searchMemory API method, and registering a hipcortex_causal LM tool.

nodes.name: Fix Extension Dispatch Design
nodes.summary: Pure TypeScript change to vscode-extension/src/extension.ts only. Defines four design decisions: scored vs raw result formatting for search vs query, searchMemory on HipCortexAPI class, mode discriminator for hipcortex_causal tool, and axios usage pattern. Includes precise file map with line numbers for each change.

nodes.name: Fix Extension Dispatch Tasks
